races.method: Early and Election Day gap from the generic average; early bucket (mail + early in-person) moved 77% of the way toward the VoteHub early vote tracker (2026-10-29, 5987623 ballots); county early/mail pattern from the VoteHub county tracker (2026-11-01, 7387192 ballots): early set to the tracker (most of the expected vote is in); Election Day offsets so county toplines are unchanged; expected votes and early/Election Day mix from the VoteHub tracker (Nov 1: early and mail ballots cast plus VoteHub's projected remaining, 10,083,717 total); early and Election Day keep VoteHub's county gap between cast and remaining votes and are set so each county hits our topline; county toplines from the VoteHub county forecast (Nov 2), with expected votes per county following that forecast and the early/Election Day split from the tracker (cast vs projected remaining); early and Election Day placed around them with VoteHub's cast-vs-remaining gap; Denton County held at D+1.0

races.label: AZ-Gov

races.label: FL-Gov

races.label: MI-Gov

races.label: NV-Gov
races.method: Nevada counting order: first drop (early in-person and mail received by Election Day, 69%), Election Day (21%), late mail and cured ballots (10%, assumed share, margin set equal to the mail margin). Built from the NBC 2024 mail/early/Election Day tracker; first drop moved 75% (late mail 76%) of the way toward the VoteHub early vote tracker (2026-10-30, 524213 ballots); county early/mail pattern from the VoteHub county tracker (2026-10-30, 584071 ballots): first drop set to the tracker (most of the expected vote is in); late mail and cured ballots keep the statewide margin, county pattern moved 75% toward the tracker; Election Day offsets so county toplines are unchanged; vote mix set Nov 2: first drop raised to the 732,715 early votes cast (308,019 in person, 424,696 mail) plus ~25k mail still arriving by post, spread by county from the VoteHub tracker; Election Day and late mail votes kept, so expected turnout rises; Election Day keeps each county's margin
